## File: algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/examples/signal_processing/evaluator.py

Prompts

```
['run the full evaluation of a signal processing program file and return composite scores', 'run a quick stage 1 validation that the signal processing program runs without errors', 'run the full stage 2 evaluation with all test signals on a program file', 'calculate the weighted composite metric from slope changes, lag error, average error, and false reversals', 'generate multiple noisy and clean test signal pairs with varying characteristics for evaluation', 'run the signal processing algorithm on a synthetic test signal and print correlation and noise reduction metrics', 'generate a synthetic noisy test signal with multiple frequency components and non-stationary behavior', 'process an input time series using either a basic or enhanced sliding window filter', 'refactor the enhanced filter to use a different weighting scheme for trend preservation', 'review the adaptive filter sliding window implementation for performance improvements']
```

Usage

```
{'run_evaluate': 'run the full evaluation of a signal processing program file and return composite scores', 'run_evaluate_stage1': 'run a quick stage 1 validation that the signal processing program runs without errors', 'run_evaluate_stage2': 'run the full stage 2 evaluation with all test signals on a program file', 'calculate_composite_score': 'calculate the weighted composite metric from slope changes, lag error, average error, and false reversals', 'generate_test_signals': 'generate multiple noisy and clean test signal pairs with varying characteristics for evaluation'}
```
